title: nogyo
tagline: A marketplace to connect farmers with consumers with supply chain validation ensuring fair and equitable prices.
description: At nogyo, our goal is to allow you to find the finest, sustainably sourced coffee beans directly from a farm to your cup. Our mission is to support small, family owned farms and farmers while ensuring you get the best coffee and the farmers get paid fairly. The project allows for producers to create smart contracts that represent coffee and list them for sale.
how_its_made: This project is build using a Django backend and etc smart contracts. hardhat was used to develop and test the smart contracts. The front end is built in react, with the backend build using Django. The users information is stored in a sqlite3 database the the frontend currently being hosted on fleek
